Clear expectations

Before you decide

Delivery and fulfilment

The supplier listing showed free standard shipping to the United Kingdom with a delivery window of 19–24 November. AURA has not confirmed a destination list, a shipping rate, or a dispatch commitment, and promises no delivery date in this preview.

Returns and support

AURA’s returns and support terms will be published before sales open. The supplier advertises 90-day free returns; that is the supplier’s policy, not AURA’s, and has not been verified.

Directions and product information

Read the current supplier description, full ingredient list, directions, and warnings before use. This page makes no treatment, prevention, or skin-tone claim.

Verification register

What has been checked

Claims we will not make

These words appear on the supplier listing. AURA does not repeat them, because no evidence has been provided for them.

  • Treats or prevents acne
  • Reduces spots or breakouts
  • Brightens, whitens, or evens skin tone
  • Controls oil
  • Inhibits melanin production
  • Clinically proven
  • Dermatologist tested
  • Handmade
  • Natural or chemical-free

A claim leaves this list only when matching evidence is verified and recorded.
